ui.title: Schedules
ui.timezoneFromHub: Taken from the hub: it is declared in Settings, or deduced from the country of the business. It is the single clock the schedule is read with, so it is shown here and changed there.
ui.timezoneUnknown: Not published by this hub yet
ui.defaultWeekNotice: These are default opening hours we set up for you. Check they match your business — bookings outside them are refused.
ui.errorConfirmWeek: Could not confirm the opening hours
ui.errorCreateSpecialDay: Could not create the special day
ui.errorHoursRequired: Enter opening and closing times, or mark it as closed
ui.deleteConfirmMessage: «{name}» will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
ui.intervalsHint: Split shifts: one line per interval (10:00–14:00 and 17:00–20:00). A closing time earlier than the opening one runs past midnight (22:00–02:00).

setup.title: Confirm your opening hours
setup.description: We set up a default week for you (Monday to Friday, 09:00–18:00). If it matches your business, confirm it in one tap; if not, edit the days that differ — bookings outside your opening hours are refused.

errors.schedules.invalid_hours: Those opening hours are not valid: times are HH:MM and close must come after open (00:00–00:00 means open 24 hours).
errors.schedules.invalid_break: That break is not valid: it needs a start and an end, inside the opening hours.
errors.schedules.invalid_date: That date is not valid: it must be a real calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD).
errors.schedules.invalid_day: The day of the week must be between Monday and Sunday.
errors.schedules.invalid_range: The end date cannot be before the start date.
errors.schedules.missing_hours: An open day needs at least one opening interval.
errors.schedules.missing_items: The list of special days cannot be empty.
errors.schedules.already_exists: There is already a special day on that date.
errors.schedules.overlapping: Two intervals overlap (or one runs past midnight into another); adjust the times so they do not clash.
